lineages.name: Ashborn
lineages.summary: Heat-scarred pilgrims born near living cinders, built for bold strikes and ember resistance.

passive.name: Cinder Heart
passive.summary: Burning rooms and ember foes are easier to endure.

cityReputationHooks.summary: Forge crews greet Ashborn as kin of the furnace.

lineages.spritePaletteNotes: Hot orange cloak marks, charcoal shadows, small ember eye glow.
lineages.originText: You woke near a dead kiln that still knew your name.
lineages.questHook: An Ashborn flame-rite in Cinderfall asks whether old furnaces deserve mercy.

lineages.name: Veyr Human
lineages.summary: Oath-city heirs with balanced instincts, strong civic ties, and reliable shieldcraft.

passive.name: Civic Oath
passive.summary: Veyrhold vendors and wardens trust your spoken promises sooner.

cityReputationHooks.summary: Veyrhold opens militia and hearth doors earlier.

lineages.spritePaletteNotes: Warm bronze cloth, hearth-gold trim, steady readable silhouette.
lineages.originText: Your first oath was written on a bellroot leaf and sealed by candle wax.
lineages.questHook: A forged oath in Oathmarket can be solved through lineage testimony.

lineages.name: Glasskin
lineages.summary: Reflection-touched wanderers whose bodies catch light and lies with equal ease.

passive.name: Prism Sense
passive.summary: Illusions and mirror-doors reveal their edges faster.

cityReputationHooks.summary: The Lens Court treats your reflection as legal evidence.

lineages.spritePaletteNotes: Sea-glass highlights, pale cyan rim, bright reflection shards.
lineages.originText: You learned your true name from a mirror that refused to flatter you.
lineages.questHook: A Glasskin can cross-examine their own reflection in Lenswright Court.

lineages.name: Mossbound
lineages.summary: Green-blooded survivors of bone gardens, patient healers with stubborn wards.

passive.name: Root Memory
passive.summary: Shrines and healing groves restore a little more resolve.

cityReputationHooks.summary: Bone gardeners recognize old root-cant in your voice.

lineages.spritePaletteNotes: Moss cloak edge, bark-brown boots, soft green glow on hands.
lineages.originText: You were found asleep under a rib-bough that kept blooming in winter.
lineages.questHook: The Green Crypts offer a Mossbound-only choice between burial and rebirth.

lineages.name: Iron Oath
lineages.summary: Vow-forged bodies raised by bastion rites, slow to bend and hard to break.

passive.name: Steadfast Frame
passive.summary: Heavy armor costs less speed and stagger checks favor you.

cityReputationHooks.summary: Bastion quartermasters recognize the stamp of your oath-frame.

lineages.spritePaletteNotes: Bronze plates, iron cloak pin, compact heavy silhouette.
lineages.originText: Your first memory is a hammer striking a vow into a cooling chestplate.
lineages.questHook: Bannerhouse veterans challenge Iron Oath heroes to prove the vow still means defense.

lineages.name: Nacre-Touched
lineages.summary: Pearl-lit descendants of drowned archives, tuned to tide memory and hidden doors.

passive.name: Tide Memory
passive.summary: Water ruins and archive locks answer your relic pulse sooner.

cityReputationHooks.summary: Shell Court records treat your pulse as a family seal.

lineages.spritePaletteNotes: Pearl-blue trims, deep navy cloth, soft tide shimmer.
lineages.originText: The sea returned you with a pearl under your tongue and no fear of deep halls.
lineages.questHook: A Nacre-Touched can read a Drowned Archive witness no one else can hear.

lineages.name: Starward
lineages.summary: Pilgrims marked by false-star dreams, gifted with focus and dangerous curiosity.

passive.name: Orbit Read
passive.summary: Orrery puzzles and star machines reveal safer paths.

cityReputationHooks.summary: Orrery scribes fear and need the pattern in your dreams.

lineages.spritePaletteNotes: Violet cloak interior, gold star pins, pale arcane eye accent.
lineages.originText: A star you never saw has been giving you directions since childhood.
lineages.questHook: The High Astrolabe can show a Starward hero one avoidable tragedy.

lineages.name: Gloammarked
lineages.summary: Twilight-border scouts whose shadows remember roads their feet never walked.

passive.name: Veil Step
passive.summary: Travel events and stealth checks lean in your favor.

cityReputationHooks.summary: Veilwatch scouts accept you as someone the border already knows.

lineages.spritePaletteNotes: Moonlit violet cloak, black boots, small moth-silver accent.
lineages.originText: Your shadow arrived in Gloamreach three days before you did.
lineages.questHook: A Gloammarked hero can choose which cursed shadow keeps following the caravan.

classTrees.name: Wardbreaker
classTrees.role: Shielded front-line breaker with readable cleaves and guard windows.

subclasses.name: Shieldcleaver
subclasses.summary: Break enemy guard and turn upgrades into pressure.

subclasses.name: Oathguard
subclasses.summary: Stand ground and protect the route forward.
subclasses.perk: Shields and armor grant extra ward.

skillNodes.name: Cinder Cleave
skillNodes.summary: A reliable arc strike that adds might scaling to the next attack.
skillNodes.comboHook: Deals more damage after equipping upgraded gear.

skillNodes.name: Bronze Guard
skillNodes.summary: Upgraded armor and shields grant extra ward.

classTrees.name: Relicweaver
classTrees.role: Machine-mystic controller built around resonance, focus, and relic puzzles.

subclasses.name: Ward-Scribe
subclasses.summary: Write safer wards into gear and gates.
subclasses.perk: Upgrade interactions cost less focus later.

skillNodes.name: Loom Surge
skillNodes.summary: Spend focus to pulse relic energy through nearby constructs.
skillNodes.comboHook: Extra pressure against constructs and oracle echoes.

skillNodes.name: Fine Tuning
skillNodes.summary: Relics and charms gain extra resonance after upgrades.
skillNodes.comboHook: Resonance improves relic foci and charm gear.

classTrees.name: Ashrunner
classTrees.role: Fast skirmisher with crit pressure, road tricks, and repositioning.

subclasses.name: Roadflame
subclasses.summary: Travel faster and turn campfire tricks into combat tempo.
subclasses.perk: Road events reveal extra route choices.

skillNodes.name: Ash Step
skillNodes.summary: A short repositioning burst that keeps combat readable and quick.
skillNodes.comboHook: Next strike gains crit when used near an enemy.

skillNodes.name: Soot Footwork
skillNodes.summary: Movement speed adds a little crit pressure.

classTrees.name: Oathblade
classTrees.role: Heroic duelist whose vows turn precise hits into party-safe momentum.

subclasses.name: Dawn Vow
subclasses.perk: First strike in each fight hits harder.

skillNodes.name: Vowstrike
skillNodes.summary: A clean sword oath that marks the target as exposed.
skillNodes.comboHook: Bonus if the hero has not been hit recently.

skillNodes.name: Raised Standard
skillNodes.summary: Oath dialogue and guard windows improve after civic choices.
skillNodes.comboHook: Pairs with shields and Veyr reputation.

classTrees.name: Thornwarden
classTrees.role: Nature/death defender who roots enemies and keeps the hero standing.

subclasses.name: Briarkeeper
subclasses.perk: Rooted foes take more basic damage.

subclasses.name: Green Bulwark
subclasses.perk: Health vials restore a little more.

skillNodes.name: Briarbind
skillNodes.summary: Bind a nearby foe with thorn roots.
skillNodes.comboHook: Rooted foes are safer to flank.

skillNodes.name: Living Bark
skillNodes.summary: A living guard layer improves ward and healing.
skillNodes.comboHook: Pairs with Mossbound lineage and healer companions.

classTrees.name: Gravechanter
classTrees.role: Bone-song caster who weakens undead and turns sorrow into control.

subclasses.name: Bone Cantor
subclasses.summary: Sing old bones awake without making them cruel.

skillNodes.name: Bone Coda
skillNodes.summary: A ringing chant that frightens fragile enemies.
skillNodes.comboHook: Fear gives space to heal or reposition.

skillNodes.name: Bellward
skillNodes.summary: Curses and silence effects lose bite around your song.
skillNodes.comboHook: Pairs with Verdant Ossuary story choices.

classTrees.name: Ember Monk
classTrees.role: Close-range fist fighter whose calm breath turns heat into tempo.

subclasses.name: Furnace Palm
subclasses.summary: Fist strikes that burn armor open.
subclasses.perk: Bare-hand and fist-wrap weapons gain might.

subclasses.name: Ash Breath
subclasses.perk: Cooldown stat improves after perfect movement.

skillNodes.name: Furnace Palm
skillNodes.summary: A palm strike that leaves a small burn on armored foes.
skillNodes.comboHook: Burn improves if used after a dodge movement.

skillNodes.name: Breath Count
skillNodes.summary: Calm breath improves cooldown recovery and focus.

classTrees.name: Wayfarer
classTrees.role: Road-smart archer and survivalist built for exploration and route events.

subclasses.name: Campfire Trickster
subclasses.summary: Route tricks, thrown blades, and better travel events.
subclasses.perk: Travel encounters reveal one safer choice.

skillNodes.name: Marked Shot
skillNodes.summary: Mark a visible enemy for a cleaner follow-up strike.
skillNodes.comboHook: Crit improves with bows, thrown knives, and distance.

skillNodes.name: Camp Trick
skillNodes.summary: Travel and campfire choices reveal safer rewards.
skillNodes.comboHook: Pairs with route events and caravan choices.
